## 1. Company Overview

JEF Techno / JEF Group is a specialist electrical engineering company focused on the safety and reliability of electrical systems.

JEF was founded in 1994 and provides electrical engineering consulting, audit services, engineering studies, protection solutions and related products for customers in India and international markets.

JEF states the following company milestones:
- 30+ years of experience
- Presence in 30+ countries
- 10K+ customers
- 9 granted patents

JEF's Global Headquarters is in Bengaluru, India. JEF also identifies Abu Dhabi, UAE as its GCC Headquarters. The website also mentions offices in Al Khobar, Saudi Arabia and Plano, Texas, USA.

## 2. Leadership

Prashanth BG is the Chairman and Managing Director of JEF Group.

## 3. Core Focus

JEF's core focus is the safety, reliability and engineering performance of electrical systems.

The company's areas of expertise include:
- Earthing / Grounding Studies
- Lightning Protection Studies
- Power System Studies
- Power Quality Studies
- Instrumentation Earthing
- Electrical and Fire Safety Audits
- Earthing Health Assessment
- Lightning Protection Audits
- EMI / EMC Studies
- Root Cause Analysis

## 4. Business Areas

JEF's website presents three major business categories:

### 4.1 Products and market offerings

JEF provides electrical protection and engineering products and solutions. Services and proprietary technologies are represented separately in the structured AI knowledge layer; they should not be interpreted as products merely because they appear in a business category.
- CLPS
- Earthing / Grounding solutions
- ESE lightning protection
- ESE Nimbus

- Surge Protection Devices

- Instrumentation Earthing System solutions
- Lightning Protection Audit-related solutions
- Power Quality Studies-related solutions
- Electrical & Fire Safety solutions

- Renewable Power System Studies
- Root Cause Analysis
- EMI & EMC

### 4.2 Audit Services

JEF provides audit and assessment services including:
- Electrical and Fire Safety Audit
- Earthing Health Assessment of live installations
- Instrumentation Earthing Audit for I&C systems
- Lightning Protection Audit
- Power Quality Studies

The website describes the JEF Safety Audit Tool as a proprietary technology used in its electrical and fire safety audit offering.

### 4.3 Consulting Services

JEF provides electrical engineering consulting services including:
- Power System Studies
- Earthing / Grounding Studies
- Lightning Protection Studies
- Instrumentation Earthing
- Power Quality Studies
- EMI / EMC Studies
- Industrial Power System Studies
- Renewable Power System Studies
- Root Cause Analysis

The consulting offering includes power system studies using ETAP, PSCAD/EMTDC, PSS/E, DIgSILENT, SKM and DSA tools.

The EMI / EMC offering includes AC interference analysis for pipelines.

## 5. Earthing and Grounding

JEF provides earthing and grounding engineering solutions for electrical installations and infrastructure.

The offering includes:
- Earthing / grounding studies
- Earthing system design and engineering
- Earthing health assessment
- Earth-grid simulation
- Instrumentation earthing
- Earthing integrity assessment

For power utilities, JEF describes EHV and HV substation earthing and earth-grid simulation using CDEGS.

## 6. Lightning Protection

JEF provides lightning protection engineering and products covering:
- Lightning protection studies
- Lightning protection system design
- Lightning protection audits
- Lightning risk assessment
- Lightning protection components and systems
- Early Streamer Emission (ESE) solutions
- Surge protection

JEF Shield is described on the JEF website as patented automated software for lightning protection risk assessment to IEC 62305-2. The website states that it produces a report and bill of materials in under 90 seconds.

## 7. Power System Studies

JEF provides power system studies for industrial, utility, infrastructure and renewable-energy applications.

The consulting capability includes studies using:
- ETAP
- PSCAD/EMTDC
- PSS/E
- DIgSILENT
- SKM
- DSA tools

The website presents separate industrial and renewable power system study offerings.

## 8. Power Quality

JEF provides power quality studies as part of its electrical engineering and audit capabilities.

Power quality services are relevant to assessing electrical system performance and identifying power-quality-related issues in industrial and infrastructure environments.

## 9. Instrumentation Earthing

JEF provides instrumentation earthing services for instrumentation and control (I&C) systems.

The offering includes instrumentation earthing studies and instrumentation earthing audit services.

## 10. EMI / EMC

JEF provides EMI / EMC engineering services.

The website specifically identifies AC interference analysis for pipelines as part of its EMI / EMC studies capability.

## 11. Root Cause Analysis

JEF provides Root Cause Analysis as an engineering service for investigating electrical and system-related problems and identifying underlying causes.

## 12. Products and Technologies

### JEF Shield

JEF Shield is JEF's patented automated software for lightning protection risk assessment.

According to the JEF website:
- It performs lightning protection risk assessment to IEC 62305-2.
- It produces a report and bill of materials.
- The stated output time is under 90 seconds.

### JEF E-Build

JEF E-Build is identified by JEF as one of its proprietary technologies.

### JEF Safety Audit Tool

JEF Safety Audit Tool is identified by JEF as a proprietary technology supporting its safety audit activities.

## 13. Technology and Patents

JEF states that it has 9 granted patents across:
- India

- European Union

The website identifies JEF Shield, JEF Safety Audit Tool and JEF E-Build among its proprietary technologies.

## 18. Frequently Asked Questions

### What is JEF Techno / JEF Group?

JEF is a specialist electrical engineering company founded in 1994, focused on earthing, lightning protection, power system studies and electrical safety audits, with a presence in 30+ countries and 10K+ customers.

### How many patents does JEF hold?

JEF holds 9 granted patents across India, the United States and the European Union, covering its proprietary JEF Shield, JEF Safety Audit Tool and JEF E-Build technologies.

### Where is JEF Techno headquartered?

JEF Techno's Global HQ is in Bengaluru, India, with a GCC HQ in Abu Dhabi, UAE. The website also mentions offices in Al Khobar, Saudi Arabia and Plano, Texas, USA.

### Who leads JEF Group?

Prashanth BG is the Chairman and Managing Director of JEF Group.

### What is JEF Shield?

JEF Shield is JEF's patented, automated software for lightning protection risk assessment to IEC 62305-2. It produces a report and bill of materials in under 90 seconds.

## 22. AI Knowledge Layer v2

Build ID: jef-ai-knowledge-2026-10-08-v2.0.0

The three public AI-readable artifacts are intended to represent one consistent knowledge model:
- `llms.txt` — concise AI index.
- `llms-full.txt` — detailed human-readable source-of-truth narrative.
- `ai/knowledge.json` — typed, machine-readable knowledge graph.

### 22.1 Entity taxonomy

The structured model separates:
- company
- person
- location
- service
- product
- technology
- software_tool
- industry
- standard
- claim
- intent
- action
- FAQ
- document

JEF E-Build is represented as a proprietary technology and JEF Safety Audit Tool as a software/tool entity rather than as physical products. JEF services and market offerings remain in separate namespaces.

### 22.2 Intent → service/product → action

The knowledge graph maps common buyer jobs to JEF entities and supported next actions. Examples include:
- Check an existing earthing system → Earthing Health Assessment → open service / request consultation.
- Assess lightning risk → Lightning Protection Audit or JEF Shield → open service/product / request consultation.
- Investigate recurring electrical failures → Root Cause Analysis → open service / request consultation.
- Study a solar, wind, BESS or hybrid plant → Renewable Power System Studies → open service / request consultation.
- Select or understand surge protection → Surge Protective Devices → open product / contact JEF.
- Investigate instrumentation grounding/noise issues → Instrumentation Earthing → open service / request consultation.

These mappings describe routing intent; they do not constitute a technical design recommendation without project-specific engineering review.

### 22.3 Standards representation

Where standards are referenced, the knowledge graph records the standard code, edition where supported, jurisdiction, applicability context and first-party provenance. JEF references standards in the context of its published engineering services and products; the AI layer must not convert a reference into a universal compliance claim.

### 22.4 Evidence and claim controls

Material company metrics, performance figures, experience figures and technical claims have claim-level provenance with source URL and verification date. The preferred wording for company assertions is “JEF states...”. Missing or unanswered information must remain unanswered rather than being filled from model knowledge.

### 22.5 URL and lifecycle rules

- Every leaf service and product has one canonical URL.
- Abstract industry concepts use `canonicalUrl: null` with a parent/source URL when no verified leaf page exists.
- FAQ entities use the verified JEF FAQ page as their canonical resource and keep individual question anchors in `contentRef`.
- Company metrics, office information and product/service specifications are periodic data and should be re-verified before each production release.

### 22.6 Release contract

All three artifacts must share the same build ID. Before production publication, validate JSON structure and unique IDs, check canonical URLs, resolve every `contentRef`, verify service/product coverage, detect taxonomy collisions, validate standard metadata and run the AI regression question set described below.

Expected behavior: identify the correct service/product/industry entity, use the canonical URL, cite or rely on first-party evidence, and distinguish JEF claims from independent facts.
